profile.headline: Software Engineer at K2
profile.summary:
Professional Experience: Software Developer, Web Developer, Software Support Engineer, Software Test Engineer, and Entrepreneur.

Specialties
Software: Nintex K2 Five Automation, Nintex K2 Cloud, Office 365, Azure, SharePoint, SQL Server, Windows Server, Virtual Machine Manager, C#, SQL, HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, Angular JS, Xamarin, Wordpress, most any database system, data – mining, programming languages and methodology.

Hardware: Apple (Macintosh), PC, peripherals, DSL, networking, LAN, WAN, Wifi

Energetic, outgoing, concerned, sincere, honest, desire to be appreciated for performance, quick learner, ambitious, true passion for technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing cloud based web application using ASP.NET in C#, ASP.NET MVC, SQL, Entity Framework, HTML 5, CSS 3, Javascript, JQuery, and Windows Azure.

positions.title: Software Support Engineer
positions.description:
Supporting K2 business workflow softwares: BlackPearl, BlackPoint, K2 Connect
Developing business workflow using .NET and SharePoint Integration

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description: Software Test Engineer for Windows 7 and Windows 8.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Prepared test plan and test scenarios according to the functional specs from client (Microsoft Corps). 
•	Executed manual and automated test scripts through Window Test Technology (WTT). 
•	Managed a team of 11 Software Testers.
•	Solely responsible for finding and reporting of bugs, 80% of which were resolved as “Fixed”.

positions.title: Hardware Testing Engineer
positions.description:
•	Supported the 7600 high-end routing platform projects, which includes light scripting, bring-up, configuring systems, and debugging prototype hardware. 
•	Learned how to debug hardware problems and the steps necessary to fix them.
